title: Hermite coefficients under Gaussian noise
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be square-integrable with respect to the $n$-dimensional standard Gaussian measure, and let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. For every multi-index $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$, the Hermite coefficient of the Gaussian-noise smoothing of $f$ at $\alpha$ equals $\rho^{|\alpha|}$ times the Hermite coefficient of $f$ at $\alpha$, where $|\alpha|=\sum_{i=1}^n\alpha_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is in $L^2$ for the product standard Gaussian measure
